notes: Paper (Dolan et al., arXiv:1709.00009, DESY-17-127) revises/updates existing constraints on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma in the keV-GeV mass range from electron beam dumps (E137, E141), colliders (LEP, BaBar), and SN 1987A, and provides Belle II sensitivity projections. The revised exclusion regions (beam dumps, LEP mono-photon, BaBar reinterpretation) are shown only in figures (fig. 2, 7) with no numerical tables, so those curves cannot be reliably digitized from text. The only explicit numerical limit in the text is the recalculated SN 1987A cooling bound g_agamma < 6e-9 GeV^-1 for small ALP masses (valid up to ~100 MeV, with a trapping ceiling near 7e-6 GeV^-1), encoded here as a flat two-point bound from ~10 keV to 100 MeV. Belle II projections (~1e-5 to 1e-4 GeV^-1) are sensitivity estimates, not measured limits; is_projection set false because the paper's revised beam-dump/collider/SN limits are derived from existing data.
